dabaosword.rule1: 1. Team Assignment: At the start of the game, each player is randomly assigned a hidden identity. With three or more players, half (rounded down) will be Rebels, one will be a Turn-coat, and the rest will be Ministers, forming three teams.
dabaosword.rule2: 2. Team Lives: Players can respawn until their team's total lives run out. Eliminated players reveal their identitis and spectate the game. The Rebel team has an average of 3 lives per player. The total lives of the Minister team and the Turn-coat match the Rebels' total lives (e.g., in a 5-player game, 2 Rebels share 6 lives, Ministers have 6 lives, and the Turn-coat has 6 lives; in a 6-player game, 3 Rebels share 9 lives, 2 Ministers share 9 lives, and the Turn-coat has 9 lives).
dabaosword.rule3: 3. Scoring: Ministers gain 1 point for killing a Rebel. Rebels gain 1 point for killing a Minister. The Turn-coat gains 1 point for killing either a Minister or a Rebel. Killing a Turn-coat or a teammate does not award points.
dabaosword.rule4: 4. Victory Conditions: When all members of either the Minister or Rebel team are eliminated, if only one team remains, they win. If both the Turn-coat and another team remain, the team with the higher score wins. If the score is tied, the game continues until the Turn-coat gains score (Turn-coat wins) or dies (remaining team wins).
dabaosword.rule5: 5. Timeout Rule: If no one scores for an extended period (configurable), the game ends. If one team has the highest score, they win; otherwise, no one wins.
